title: A phpinfo page is served (/test.php)
summary: A phpinfo page leaks the full PHP configuration, paths, and loaded modules.

confirm.control: A path that cannot exist, so the site's not found answer is known.
confirm.differential: status==200 and (body_contains("phpinfo()") or body_contains("PHP Version")) and body_differs(control)

remediate: Delete phpinfo pages from the web root.
